I thrive at the intersection of data and creativity, where numbers meet narratives. Gaming isn’t just a hobby—it’s a language, and I’m here to translate player behavior into insights that shape worlds.  

At NexGen Interactive, I bridge data and design to craft immersive gaming experiences that resonate with players worldwide. My work spans from refining player engagement metrics to building models that predict retention trends in real-time.  

Led A/B testing frameworks that boosted user retention by 18% across three major titles. Engineered features for AI-driven NPC behavior, improving player satisfaction scores by 12%. Built scalable Python pipelines using Pandas and NumPy to process millions of gameplay data points, enabling faster, more accurate insights. Visualized complex datasets with Plotly, guiding cross-functional teams to data-informed design decisions. My time series analysis of player behavior uncovered hidden patterns, leading to a 25% increase in in-game purchases for one flagship title.  

I’m eager to collaborate on projects that push the boundaries of what games can achieve through data-driven storytelling. Let’s build the future—one click, one insight, one unforgettable experience at a time.
